import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Safe Output

User Content

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML page by escaping user input before inserting it into the predefined template. Parameters: user_input (str): Content provided by the user that will be added to the HTML response. Returns: str: The resulting HTML page with the escaped user content. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
